faithful_to_paper.evidence: Implements both paper techniques (Section 3.1): emoji chaining (concept-word -> emoji substitution from paper Table 1) and emoji stuffing (emoji interleaving between words). Unicode NFC normalization per Section 4. Paper keyword classifier (32 keywords per class: Successful/Partial/Failed) faithfully reconstructed from Section 4 descriptions. Deliberately WEAK attack (paper JSR ~10%); our keyword JSR = 10% (overall), matching paper. No tuning to inflate ASR.

no_cheating.evidence: All 60 results from live deepseek/deepseek-chat API calls via OpenRouter with 0 provider/runtime errors. All outputs non-empty (min 124 chars, avg 1139 chars). Chaining prompts verified to contain emoji substitutions. Stuffing prompts verified to contain interleaved emojis. Direct baseline provides honest comparison. No fake/smoke outputs.

self_contained.evidence: Paper-local scripts + data/emoji_map.json + full data/advbench_harmful_behaviors.csv (520) with the recorded 20-row slice data/advbench_subset_20.csv. No external framework imports. Only requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY and the openai Python package. All inputs tracked in data/.

model_flexible_fast.evidence: --target-model, --judge-model accept any OpenRouter model ID. --dataset, --emoji-map, --modes, --sample support full parameter flexibility. Resumable via per-case writes (idempotent skip-if-done).

result_comparable.evidence: Results record per-case: original goal, emoji-encoded prompt, target response, triple judge verdicts (dual rule-based, paper keyword classifier, LLM dual). Per-mode breakdown with dual ASR + keyword JSR. Direct baseline included for lift comparison. model_substitution_run labeled.
